dataset: American Community Survey Public Use Microdata Sample (acs/acs1/pums)
notes: PUMS is a sample of person records; weighted cell counts estimate population counts with sampling error that is not computed here (no replicate weights).
Missing values in grouping columns are kept as their own cell; their meaning is the variable's universe in the PUMS data dictionary.
Kept 10249 of 10249 person record(s) inside AGEP in [55, 75].
Aggregated to 194 cell(s) from 10249 person record(s); 183 cell(s) with fewer than 10 records were withheld (822 record(s), weighted 73,525). No person-level row is returned.
